newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's Q3 GDP grew 1.8 pct - Statistics Bureau.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Q3 GDP grew 1.8 pct - Statistics Bureau.

text.p: Norway's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 1.8 percent in the third quarter of 1996, up from 0.7 percent in the second quarter, the Statistics Bureau said on Thursday.
Mainland GDP rose 1.2 percent against growth of 0.4 percent in the second quarter.
The Statistics Bureau said private consumption rose 1.4 percent in the third quarter, while public consumption fell by 0.3 percent.
Third-quarter gross investment climbed 1.9 percent, with exports rising 1.6 percent and imports 2.4 percent, it said.
